theorem imo2015p1_balanced_center_free_card_odd(s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
  (hcard : 3 ≤ s.card)
  (hbal : ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, A ≠ B → ∃ C ∈ s, dist A C = dist B C)
  (hfree : ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, ∀ C ∈ s,
    A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C ∧ A ≠ C →
      ¬∃ P ∈ s, dist P A = dist P B ∧ dist P B = dist P C) :
  Odd s.card := by
  classical
  have hnot : ¬ Even s.card := by
    intro heven
    have hlower := imo2015p1_offdiag_card_le_sum_centerPairs s hbal
    have hupper :
        ∑ P ∈ s, (imo2015p1_centerPairs s P).card ≤
          s.card * (s.card - 2) := by
      calc
        ∑ P ∈ s, (imo2015p1_centerPairs s P).card ≤
            ∑ P ∈ s, (s.card - 2) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro P hP
              exact imo2015p1_centerPairs_card_le_of_even s P hP heven hfree
        _ = s.card * (s.card - 2) := by simp
    have hdiff : s.card - 2 < s.card - 1 := by omega
    have hpos : 0 < s.card := by omega
    have hstrict : s.card * (s.card - 2) < s.card * (s.card - 1) := by
      exact (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hpos).2 hdiff
    omega
  exact Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hnot

theorem sorrydb_23c6b58a01c67d53(Balanced : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Prop)
  (hb₀ : ∀ (s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))), Balanced s ↔ ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, A ≠ B → ∃ C ∈ s, dist A C = dist B C)
  (center_free : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) → Prop)
  (hb₁ :
    ∀ (s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))),
      center_free s ↔
        ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, ∀ C ∈ s, A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C ∧ A ≠ C → ¬∃ P ∈ s, dist P A = dist P B ∧ dist P B = dist P C) :
  (∀ n ≥ 3, ∃ (s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))), Balanced s ∧ s.card = n) ∧
    {n : ℕ | 3 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))), Balanced s ∧ center_free s ∧ s.card = n} =
      {n : ℕ | 3 ≤ n ∧ Odd n} := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro n hn
    have hm : 2 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
    rcases imo2015p1_plane_circle_neighbor_finset (n - 1) hm with
      ⟨t, htcard, h0, hsphere, hneighbor⟩
    rcases imo2015p1_insert_center_balanced t h0 hsphere hneighbor with
      ⟨hbal, hcard⟩
    refine ⟨insert (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) t, (hb₀ _).2 hbal, ?_⟩
    omega
  · ext n
    change (3 ≤ n ∧ ∃ s, Balanced s ∧ center_free s ∧ s.card = n) ↔
      (3 ≤ n ∧ Odd n)
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hn, s, hbs, hcfs, hcard⟩
      have hbal := (hb₀ s).1 hbs
      have hfree := (hb₁ s).1 hcfs
      have hcard3 : 3 ≤ s.card := by omega
      have hodd := imo2015p1_balanced_center_free_card_odd s hcard3 hbal hfree
      exact ⟨hn, by simpa only [hcard] using hodd⟩
    · rintro ⟨hn, hodd⟩
      rcases imo2015p1_odd_balanced_spherical_set n hn hodd with
        ⟨s, O, r, hcard, hO, hr, hsphere, hbal⟩
      have hfree := imo2015p1_spherical_set_center_free s O r hO hsphere
      exact ⟨hn, s, (hb₀ s).2 hbal, (hb₁ s).2 hfree, hcard⟩

def imo2015P2Cond (a b c : ℤ) : Prop :=
  0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c ∧ a ≤ b ∧ b ≤ c ∧
  (∃ p : ℕ, a * b - c = 2 ^ p) ∧
  (∃ q : ℕ, b * c - a = 2 ^ q) ∧
  (∃ r : ℕ, c * a - b = 2 ^ r)

theorem imo2015_p2_power_order(a b c : ℤ) (p q r : ℕ)
  (hab : a * b - c = 2 ^ p) (hbc : b * c - a = 2 ^ q)
  (hca : c * a - b = 2 ^ r)
  (hpos : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c) (habc : a ≤ b ∧ b ≤ c) : p ≤ r ∧ r ≤ q := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ p := by positivity
  have hq : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ q := by positivity
  have hr : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ r := by positivity
  have ha : -1 ≤ a := by
    rcases habc with ⟨habord, hbcord⟩
    nlinarith
  have hc : -1 ≤ c := by
    exact le_trans ha (le_trans habc.1 habc.2)
  have hpr : (2 : ℤ) ^ p ≤ 2 ^ r := by
    rw [← hab, ← hca]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ a + 1) (sub_nonneg.mpr habc.2)]
  have hrq : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ≤ 2 ^ q := by
    rw [← hca, ← hbc]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ c + 1) (sub_nonneg.mpr habc.1)]
  have hprNat : (2 : ℕ) ^ p ≤ 2 ^ r := by
    exact_mod_cast hpr
  have hrqNat : (2 : ℕ) ^ r ≤ 2 ^ q := by
    exact_mod_cast hrq
  constructor
  · exact (pow_le_pow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2)).mp hprNat
  · exact (pow_le_pow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2)).mp hrqNat

theorem imo2015_p2_even_decomp(z : ℤ) (hz : 0 < z) (he : Even z) :
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (u : ℤ), 0 < k ∧ 0 < u ∧ Odd u ∧ z = (2 : ℤ) ^ k * u := by
  have hn : z.natAbs ≠ 0 := by
    exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hz)
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hn with ⟨k, u, huodd, hfac⟩
  have hznonneg : 0 ≤ z := le_of_lt hz
  have hzabs : (z.natAbs : ℤ) = z := by
    exact Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hznonneg
  have hfacZ : (z.natAbs : ℤ) = (2 : ℤ) ^ k * (u : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfac
  have huoddZ : Odd (u : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast huodd
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hu0
    subst u
    norm_num at huodd
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hk
    subst k
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at hfacZ
    have htwoz : (2 : ℤ) ∣ z := (even_iff_two_dvd).mp he
    have htwou : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (u : ℤ) := by
      rw [← hfacZ, hzabs]
      exact htwoz
    have htwouNat : 2 ∣ u := by
      exact_mod_cast htwou
    exact huodd.not_two_dvd_nat htwouNat
  refine ⟨k, (u : ℤ), Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0, ?_, huoddZ, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hu0
  · rw [← hzabs]
    exact hfacZ

theorem imo2015_p2_pow_dvd_pow_mul_odd(m n : ℕ) (u : ℤ) (hu : Odd u)
  (h : (2 : ℤ) ^ m ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ n * u) : m ≤ n := by
  by_contra hmn
  have hnm : n < m := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hmn
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hnm)
  rcases h with ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hcancel : u = (2 : ℤ) ^ k * z := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero n (by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0))
    calc
      (2 : ℤ) ^ n * u = (2 : ℤ) ^ m * z := hz
      _ = (2 : ℤ) ^ n * ((2 : ℤ) ^ k * z) := by rw [hk, pow_add]; ring
  have htwo : (2 : ℤ) ∣ u := by
    rw [hcancel]
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
    simp only [pow_succ]
    refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) ^ j * z, ?_⟩
    ring
  rcases hu with ⟨a, ha⟩
  rcases htwo with ⟨b, hb⟩
  omega

theorem imo2015_p2_parity_cases(a b c : ℤ) (h : imo2015P2Cond a b c) :
  (Even a ∧ Even b ∧ Even c) ∨ (Odd a ∧ Odd b ∧ Odd c) ∨
    (Even a ∧ Even b ∧ Odd c) := by
  unfold imo2015P2Cond at h
  rcases h with ⟨ha, hb, hc, hab_le, hbc_le, ⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨q, hq⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
  have hord : p ≤ r ∧ r ≤ q :=
    imo2015_p2_power_order a b c p q r hp hq hr ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ ⟨hab_le, hbc_le⟩
  have pow_odd_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd ((2 : ℤ) ^ n)) : n = 0 := by
    rcases Int.odd_pow.mp hn with htwo | hn0
    · exfalso
      exact (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr (by norm_num)) htwo
    · exact hn0
  have all_equal_of_pq_zero (hp0 : p = 0) (hq0 : q = 0) : a = b ∧ b = c := by
    have hp1 : a * b - c = 1 := by
      simpa only [hp0, pow_zero] using hp
    have hq1 : b * c - a = 1 := by
      simpa only [hq0, pow_zero] using hq
    have hfac : (a - c) * (b + 1) = 0 := by
      calc
        (a - c) * (b + 1) = (a * b - c) - (b * c - a) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by omega
    have hac : a = c := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with hzero | hzero
      · omega
      · omega
    constructor <;> omega
  rcases Int.even_or_odd a with ha_even | ha_odd
  · rcases Int.even_or_odd b with hb_even | hb_odd
    · rcases Int.even_or_odd c with hc_even | hc_odd
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ha_even, hb_even, hc_even⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨ha_even, hb_even, hc_odd⟩)
    · rcases Int.even_or_odd c with hc_even | hc_odd
      · have hp_ne : p ≠ 0 :=
          (Int.even_pow.mp (hp ▸ (ha_even.mul_right b).sub hc_even)).2
        have hr0 : r = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hr ▸ (hc_even.mul_right a).sub_odd hb_odd)
        omega
      · have hp0 : p = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hp ▸ (ha_even.mul_right b).sub_odd hc_odd)
        have hq0 : q = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hq ▸ (hb_odd.mul hc_odd).sub_even ha_even)
        have hall := all_equal_of_pq_zero hp0 hq0
        exfalso
        rw [hall.1] at ha_even
        exact (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr ha_even) hb_odd
  · rcases Int.even_or_odd b with hb_even | hb_odd
    · rcases Int.even_or_odd c with hc_even | hc_odd
      · have hp_ne : p ≠ 0 :=
          (Int.even_pow.mp (hp ▸ (hb_even.mul_left a).sub hc_even)).2
        have hq0 : q = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hq ▸ (hb_even.mul_right c).sub_odd ha_odd)
        omega
      · have hp0 : p = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hp ▸ (hb_even.mul_left a).sub_odd hc_odd)
        have hq0 : q = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hq ▸ (hb_even.mul_right c).sub_odd ha_odd)
        have hall := all_equal_of_pq_zero hp0 hq0
        exfalso
        rw [hall.1] at ha_odd
        exact (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hb_even) ha_odd
    · rcases Int.even_or_odd c with hc_even | hc_odd
      · have hp0 : p = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hp ▸ (ha_odd.mul hb_odd).sub_even hc_even)
        have hq0 : q = 0 :=
          pow_odd_zero (hq ▸ (hc_even.mul_left b).sub_odd ha_odd)
        have hall := all_equal_of_pq_zero hp0 hq0
        exfalso
        rw [hall.2] at hb_odd
        exact (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hc_even) hb_odd
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨ha_odd, hb_odd, hc_odd⟩)

theorem imo2015_p2_a_eq_two(b c : ℤ) (h : imo2015P2Cond 2 b c) :
  (b = 2 ∧ c = 2) ∨ (b = 2 ∧ c = 3) ∨ (b = 6 ∧ c = 11) := by
  rcases h with ⟨ha, hb, hc, hab, hbc, ⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨q, hq⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
  have hord : p ≤ r ∧ r ≤ q :=
    imo2015_p2_power_order 2 b c p q r hp hq hr ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ ⟨hab, hbc⟩
  rcases hord with ⟨hpr, hrq⟩
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      norm_num at hp
      have hcform : c = 2 * b - 1 := by omega
      subst c
      have hid : 9 * (2 : ℤ) ^ q = 2 * ((2 : ℤ) ^ r) ^ 2 + 5 * (2 : ℤ) ^ r - 16 := by
        nlinarith [hr, hq]
      have hrlt : r < 5 := by
        by_contra hnot
        have h5r : 5 ≤ r := by omega
        have h5q : 5 ≤ q := le_trans h5r hrq
        have hdivr : (32 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ r := by
          refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) ^ (r - 5), ?_⟩
          calc
            (2 : ℤ) ^ r = 2 ^ (5 + (r - 5)) := by congr 1 <;> omega
            _ = 2 ^ 5 * 2 ^ (r - 5) := by rw [pow_add]
            _ = 32 * 2 ^ (r - 5) := by norm_num
        have hdivq : (32 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ q := by
          refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) ^ (q - 5), ?_⟩
          calc
            (2 : ℤ) ^ q = 2 ^ (5 + (q - 5)) := by congr 1 <;> omega
            _ = 2 ^ 5 * 2 ^ (q - 5) := by rw [pow_add]
            _ = 32 * 2 ^ (q - 5) := by norm_num
        rcases hdivr with ⟨R, hR⟩
        rcases hdivq with ⟨Q, hQ⟩
        rw [hR, hQ] at hid
        ring_nf at hid
        omega
      interval_cases r <;> norm_num at hr ⊢ <;> omega
  | succ p =>
      cases r with
      | zero => omega
      | succ r =>
          cases q with
          | zero => omega
          | succ q =>
              have hc_even : ∃ C : ℤ, c = 2 * C := by
                refine ⟨b - (2 : ℤ) ^ p, ?_⟩
                rw [pow_succ] at hp
                omega
              have hb_even : ∃ B : ℤ, b = 2 * B := by
                refine ⟨c - (2 : ℤ) ^ r, ?_⟩
                rw [pow_succ] at hr
                omega
              rcases hc_even with ⟨C, rfl⟩
              rcases hb_even with ⟨B, rfl⟩
              cases q with
              | zero =>
                  have hpz : p = 0 := by omega
                  have hrz : r = 0 := by omega
                  subst p
                  subst r
                  norm_num at hp hr hq ⊢
                  omega
              | succ q =>
                  rw [pow_succ, pow_succ] at hq
                  ring_nf at hq
                  omega

theorem imo2015_p2_a_eq_three(b c : ℤ) (h : imo2015P2Cond 3 b c) : b = 5 ∧ c = 7 := by
  rcases h with ⟨ha, hb, hc, hab, hbc, ⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨q, hq⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
  have hord : p ≤ r ∧ r ≤ q :=
    imo2015_p2_power_order 3 b c p q r hp hq hr ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ ⟨hab, hbc⟩
  norm_num at hp hq hr
  have hlin : 8 * b = (2 : ℤ) ^ r + 3 * (2 : ℤ) ^ p := by
    omega
  have hpr : p < r := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hord.1 with hlt | heq
    · exact hlt
    · exfalso
      subst r
      have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by
        by_contra hn
        have hp2 : p ≤ 2 := by omega
        interval_cases p <;> norm_num at hlin <;> omega
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, p = k + 3 :=
        ⟨p - 3, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, q = l + 3 :=
        ⟨q - 3, by omega⟩
      rw [hk] at hp hlin
      rw [hl] at hq
      norm_num [pow_add] at hp hq hlin
      have hbform : b = 4 * (2 : ℤ) ^ k := by omega
      have hcform : c = 4 * (2 : ℤ) ^ k := by omega
      rw [hbform, hcform] at hq
      ring_nf at hq
      omega
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by
    by_contra hn
    have hpz : p = 0 := by omega
    subst p
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℕ, r = s + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hs] at hr
    norm_num [pow_add] at hp hr
    omega
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by omega
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, q = t + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have hq' := hq
  rw [ht] at hq'
  norm_num [pow_add] at hq'
  have hodd_bc : Odd (b * c) := by
    refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) ^ t + 1, ?_⟩
    omega
  have hodds : Odd b ∧ Odd c := Int.odd_mul.mp hodd_bc
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hrp⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ r = p + n :=
    ⟨r - p, by omega, by omega⟩
  rw [hrp, pow_add] at hlin
  have hfactor : (2 : ℤ) ^ 3 * b = (2 : ℤ) ^ p * ((2 : ℤ) ^ n + 3) := by
    norm_num at hlin ⊢
    ring_nf at hlin ⊢
    exact hlin
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℕ, n = s + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hodd_factor : Odd ((2 : ℤ) ^ n + 3) := by
    rw [hs, pow_add]
    refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) ^ s + 1, ?_⟩
    ring
  have hp_le3 : p ≤ 3 := by
    apply imo2015_p2_pow_dvd_pow_mul_odd p 3 b hodds.1
    refine ⟨(2 : ℤ) ^ n + 3, ?_⟩
    exact hfactor
  have h3_lep : 3 ≤ p := by
    apply imo2015_p2_pow_dvd_pow_mul_odd 3 p ((2 : ℤ) ^ n + 3) hodd_factor
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    exact hfactor.symm
  have hpe : p = 3 := by omega
  subst p
  norm_num at hfactor
  have hbform : b = (2 : ℤ) ^ n + 3 := by omega
  have hcform : c = 3 * (2 : ℤ) ^ n + 1 := by omega
  have hnlt : n < 2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    have hk0 : 0 < k := by omega
    have hfinal : (2 : ℤ) ^ q = (2 : ℤ) ^ (k + 2) * (3 * (2 : ℤ) ^ k + 5) := by
      rw [hbform, hcform, hk, pow_add] at hq
      norm_num [pow_add] at hq ⊢
      ring_nf at hq ⊢
      exact hq.symm
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hodd_last : Odd (3 * (2 : ℤ) ^ k + 5) := by
      rw [hj, pow_add]
      refine ⟨3 * (2 : ℤ) ^ j + 2, ?_⟩
      ring
    have hq_le : q ≤ k + 2 := by
      apply imo2015_p2_pow_dvd_pow_mul_odd q (k + 2)
        (3 * (2 : ℤ) ^ k + 5) hodd_last
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_one]
      exact hfinal.symm
    omega
  have hne : n = 1 := by omega
  rw [hne] at hbform hcform
  norm_num at hbform hcform
  exact ⟨hbform, hcform⟩

theorem imo2015_p2_all_even(a b c : ℤ) (h : imo2015P2Cond a b c)
  (ha : Even a) (hb : Even b) (hc : Even c) : a = 2 ∧ b = 2 ∧ c = 2 := by
  have hfull := h
  rcases h with ⟨ha_pos, hb_pos, hc_pos, hab_le, hbc_le,
    ⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨q, hq⟩, ⟨r, hr⟩⟩
  have hrq : r ≤ q :=
    (imo2015_p2_power_order a b c p q r hp hq hr
      ⟨ha_pos, hb_pos, hc_pos⟩ ⟨hab_le, hbc_le⟩).2
  have hpow_dvd : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ q := by
    exact pow_dvd_pow 2 hrq
  have hR_dvd_B : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ b * c - a := by
    rw [hq]
    exact hpow_dvd
  have hR_dvd_C : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ c * a - b := by
    rw [hr]
  have hR_dvd_prod : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ a * (c ^ 2 - 1) := by
    have h1 : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ c * (c * a - b) := by
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hR_dvd_C c
    have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ c * (c * a - b) + (b * c - a) :=
      dvd_add h1 hR_dvd_B
    convert h2 using 1 <;> ring
  have hcodd : Odd (c ^ 2 - 1) := by
    rcases hc with ⟨d, hd⟩
    rw [hd]
    use 2 * d ^ 2 - 1
    ring
  have hana : a.natAbs ≠ 0 := by
    exact Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hana with ⟨k, m, hm, ham⟩
  have ha_repr : a = (2 : ℤ) ^ k * (m : ℤ) := by
    have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a := by omega
    have hcast : (a.natAbs : ℤ) = a := by
      rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg ha_nonneg]
    rw [← hcast]
    exact_mod_cast ham
  have hmz : Odd (m : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hm
  have hodd : Odd ((m : ℤ) * (c ^ 2 - 1)) := hmz.mul hcodd
  have hrk : r ≤ k := by
    apply imo2015_p2_pow_dvd_pow_mul_odd r k ((m : ℤ) * (c ^ 2 - 1)) hodd
    rw [ha_repr] at hR_dvd_prod

theorem imo2015_p2_odd_sq_sub_one_pow_bound(c : ℤ) (r : ℕ) (hc : 1 < c) (hodd : Odd c)

    obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 2 :=

  have hprod : c ^ 2 - 1 = (2 : ℤ) ^ (s + t) * ((u : ℤ) * (v : ℤ)) := by

      _ = 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ s := by rw [ht]; norm_num; ring

theorem imo2015_p2_all_odd(a b c : ℤ) (h : imo2015P2Cond a b c)

    have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ^ r ∣ c * (c * a - b) + (b * c - a) := h1.add hpow_dvd_B
    convert h2 using 1 <;> ring

  have hncast : (n : ℤ) = c ^ 2 - 1 := by

  obtain ⟨s, u, hu, hsu⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hn_ne

    {t : Set C} (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    (η ⊗ₘ κ).restrict (t ×ˢ Set.univ) = (η.restrict t) ⊗ₘ κ := by
  apply Measure.ext_prod
  intro s r hs hr
  have hprod : (s ×ˢ r) ∩ (t ×ˢ Set.univ) = (s ∩ t) ×ˢ r := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true]
    tauto
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply (hs.prod hr), hprod]
  rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod (hs.inter ht) hr]
  rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod hs hr]
  rw [Measure.restrict_restrict hs]

theorem HasCondDistrib.restrict_factorization_of_const{U C E F : Type*} {mU : MeasurableSpace U} {mC : MeasurableSpace C}
    {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {mF : MeasurableSpace F} [StandardBorelSpace E] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure U} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : U → E} {Cvar : U → C}
    {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel C E} [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ]
    (hX : Measurable X) (hC : Measurable Cvar)
    (h : ProbabilityTheory.HasCondDistrib X Cvar κ μ)
    {t : Set C} (ht : MeasurableSet t) {ρ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (hκ : ∀ c ∈ t, κ c = ρ) (f : C → F) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ (X u, f (Cvar u))) =
      ρ.prod ((μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ f (Cvar u))) := by
  have hjoint : μ.map (fun u ↦ (Cvar u, X u)) = μ.map Cvar ⊗ₘ κ :=
    (condDistrib_ae_eq_iff_measure_eq_compProd (μ := μ) (Y := X) (X := Cvar)
      (κ := κ) hX.aemeasurable).mp h.condDistrib_eq
  have hCX :
      (μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ (Cvar u, X u)) =
        ((μ.map Cvar).restrict t).prod ρ := by
    apply Measure.ext_prod
    intro s r hs hr
    rw [Measure.map_apply (hC.prodMk hX) (hs.prod hr)]
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply ((hs.prod hr).preimage (hC.prodMk hX))]
    have hset :
        (fun u ↦ (Cvar u, X u)) ⁻¹' (s ×ˢ r) ∩ Cvar ⁻¹' t =
          (fun u ↦ (Cvar u, X u)) ⁻¹' ((s ∩ t) ×ˢ r) := by
      ext u
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod]
      tauto
    rw [hset, ← Measure.map_apply (hC.prodMk hX) ((hs.inter ht).prod hr), hjoint]
    rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod (hs.inter ht) hr]
    rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun (hs.inter ht) (fun c hc ↦ congrArg (fun q : Measure E ↦ q r) (hκ c hc.2))]
    rw [setLIntegral_const, Measure.prod_prod]
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply hs, Measure.map_apply hC (hs.inter ht)]
    ac_rfl
  have hCf :
      ((μ.map Cvar).restrict t).map f =
        (μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ f (Cvar u)) := by
    rw [Measure.restrict_map hC ht, Measure.map_map hf hC]
    rfl
  calc
    (μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ (X u, f (Cvar u))) =
        ((μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ (Cvar u, X u))).map
          (fun z ↦ (z.2, f z.1)) := by
      refine Eq.symm (Eq.trans (Measure.map_map
        (measurable_snd.prodMk (hf.comp measurable_fst)) (hC.prodMk hX)) ?_)
      rfl
    _ = (((μ.map Cvar).restrict t).prod ρ).map (fun z ↦ (z.2, f z.1)) := by
      rw [hCX]
    _ = ((((μ.map Cvar).restrict t).prod ρ).map Prod.swap).map (Prod.map id f) := by
      rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_id.prodMap hf) measurable_swap]
      rfl
    _ = (ρ.prod ((μ.map Cvar).restrict t)).map (Prod.map id f) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_swap]
    _ = (ρ.map id).prod (((μ.map Cvar).restrict t).map f) := by
      rw [Measure.map_prod_map ρ ((μ.map Cvar).restrict t) measurable_id hf]
    _ = ρ.prod ((μ.restrict (Cvar ⁻¹' t)).map (fun u ↦ f (Cvar u))) := by
      rw [Measure.map_id, hCf]

theorem rewardByCount_Iic_factor_on_finite_fiber{α Ω : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [DecidableEq α]
    [StandardBorelSpace α] [Nonempty α] {A : ℕ → Ω → α} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ j, Measurable (A j)) (hR : ∀ j, Measurable (R j))
    (a : α) (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f : (((↥(Finset.Iic (k - 1)) → α × ℝ) × α) × (ℕ → α → ℝ)) →
        (↥(Finset.Iic n) → ℝ),
      Measurable f ∧
      ∀ ω : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ),
        Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = (k : ℕ∞) →
        (fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic n) ↦ Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω) =
          f (((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1), ω.2)) := by
  classical
  let A' : ℕ → ((↥(Finset.Iic (k - 1)) → α × ℝ) × α) → α := fun j x ↦
    if hj : j ≤ k - 1 then (x.1 ⟨j, by simpa only [Finset.mem_Iic] using hj⟩).1 else x.2
  let R' : ℕ → ((↥(Finset.Iic (k - 1)) → α × ℝ) × α) → ℝ := fun j x ↦
    if hj : j ≤ k - 1 then (x.1 ⟨j, by simpa only [Finset.mem_Iic] using hj⟩).2 else 0
  have hA' : ∀ j, Measurable (A' j) := by
    intro j
    dsimp only [A']
    split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  have hR' : ∀ j, Measurable (R' j) := by
    intro j
    dsimp only [R']
    split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  refine ⟨fun x i ↦ Learning.rewardByCount A' R' a (i : ℕ) x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [measurable_pi_iff]
    intro i
    exact Learning.measurable_rewardByCount hA' hR' a i
  · intro ω hω
    funext i
    change Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω =
      Learning.rewardByCount A' R' a (i : ℕ)
        (((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1), ω.2))
    by_cases hi0 : (i : ℕ) = 0
    · rw [hi0, Learning.rewardByCount_zero, Learning.rewardByCount_zero]
      simp only [A', R', Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist, Nat.zero_le, ↓reduceDIte]
    · have hi_lt : (i : ℕ) < n + 1 := by
        have hi_mem := i.property
        simp only [Finset.mem_Iic] at hi_mem
        omega
      have hlt : Learning.stepsUntil A a (i : ℕ) ω.1 < (k : ℕ∞) :=
        stepsUntil_lt_of_lt_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe a ω.1 hi0 hi_lt hω
      have htop : Learning.stepsUntil A a (i : ℕ) ω.1 ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt hlt
      let j := (Learning.stepsUntil A a (i : ℕ) ω.1).toNat
      have hstep : Learning.stepsUntil A a (i : ℕ) ω.1 = (j : ℕ∞) := by
        exact (ENat.coe_toNat htop).symm
      have hjk : j < k := by
        rw [hstep] at hlt
        exact_mod_cast hlt
      have hAeq (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ j) :
          A' l (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1) = A l ω.1 := by
        dsimp only [A']
        split_ifs with h
        · rfl
        · omega
      have hReq (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ j) :
          R' l (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1) = R l ω.1 := by
        dsimp only [R']
        split_ifs with h
        · rfl
        · omega
      have hpull :
          Learning.pullCount A' a j
              (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1) =
            Learning.pullCount A a j ω.1 := by
        rw [Learning.pullCount_eq_sum, Learning.pullCount_eq_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro l hl
        rw [hAeq l (by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hl; omega)]
      have horig : A j ω.1 = a ∧
          Learning.pullCount A a j ω.1 = (i : ℕ) - 1 :=
        (Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff' (A := A) (a := a) (ω := ω.1) hi0 j).mp hstep
      have hext : Learning.stepsUntil A' a (i : ℕ)
          (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1) = (j : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff' hi0 j]
        exact ⟨(hAeq j le_rfl).trans horig.1, hpull.trans horig.2⟩
      have hleft : Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω = R j ω.1 :=
        Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hstep
      have hright : Learning.rewardByCount A' R' a (i : ℕ)
          (((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1), ω.2)) =
          R' j (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1) := by
        set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
          exact Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hext
      exact hleft.trans ((hReq j le_rfl).symm.trans hright.symm)

theorem rewardByCount_joint_restrict_stepsUntil_coe{α Ω : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [DecidableEq α]
    [StandardBorelSpace α] [Nonempty α] {A : ℕ → Ω → α} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ}
    {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ} [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν]
    [StandardBorelSpace Ω] [Nonempty Ω] [Countable α]
    (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (a : α) (n k : ℕ) :
    let μ := P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)
    let e := {ω : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = (k : ℕ∞)}
    (μ.restrict e).map (fun ω ↦
      (Learning.rewardByCount A R a (n + 1) ω,
        fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic n) ↦ Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω)) =
      (ν a).prod ((μ.restrict e).map (fun ω ↦
        fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic n) ↦ Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      have hpair : {ω : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          Learning.stepsUntil A a (0 + 1) ω.1 = ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} =
          (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹'
            {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a} := by
        ext ω
        change Learning.stepsUntil A a 1 ω.1 = 0 ↔ A 0 ω.1 = a
        rw [Learning.stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff]
        simp only [one_ne_zero, false_and, true_and, false_or]
      rw [hpair]
      have hcd : ProbabilityTheory.HasCondDistrib
          (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ R 0 p.1)
          (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2))
          (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight (ℕ → α → ℝ)
            (Learning.stationaryEnv ν).ν0)
          (P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)) :=
        HasCondDistrib.fst_prod_pair (h.measurable_R 0) (h.measurable_A 0)
          h.hasCondDistrib_reward_zero
      have ht : MeasurableSet {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a} :=
        (measurableSet_singleton a).preimage measurable_fst
      have hκ : ∀ p ∈ {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a},
          ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight (ℕ → α → ℝ)
              (Learning.stationaryEnv ν).ν0 p = ν a := by
        intro p hp
        rw [ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight_apply]
        change ν p.1 = ν a
        rw [hp]
      have hres := HasCondDistrib.restrict_factorization_of_const
        ((h.measurable_R 0).comp measurable_fst)
        (((h.measurable_A 0).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
        hcd ht hκ
        (fun p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ fun _ : ↥(Finset.Iic 0) ↦ p.2 0 a)
        (by fun_prop)
      have hevent : MeasurableSet
          ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹'
            {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a}) :=
        ht.preimage (((h.measurable_A 0).comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
      calc
        Measure.map
            (fun ω ↦
              (Learning.rewardByCount A R a (0 + 1) ω,
                fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic 0) ↦ Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω))
            ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
              ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹'
                {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a})) =
            Measure.map
              (fun ω ↦ (R 0 ω.1, fun _ : ↥(Finset.Iic 0) ↦ ω.2 0 a))
              ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
                ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹'
                  {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a})) := by
                apply Measure.map_congr
                exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hevent (fun ω hω ↦ by
                  change A 0 ω.1 = a at hω
                  apply Prod.ext
                  · exact Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
                      (Learning.stepsUntil_one_of_eq hω)
                  · funext i
                    rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
                    simp only [Finset.mem_Iic] at hi
                    have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
                    subst i
                    simp only [Learning.rewardByCount_zero, hω, ↓reduceIte])
        _ = (ν a).prod
              (Measure.map
                (fun ω ↦ fun _ : ↥(Finset.Iic 0) ↦ ω.2 0 a)
                ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
                  ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹'
                    {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a}))) := hres
        _ = (ν a).prod
              (Measure.map
                (fun ω ↦ fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic 0) ↦
                  Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω)
                ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
                  ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ (A 0 p.1, p.2)) ⁻¹'
                    {p : α × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | p.1 = a}))) := by
                congr 1
                apply Measure.map_congr
                exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hevent (fun ω hω ↦ by
                  change A 0 ω.1 = a at hω
                  funext i
                  rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
                  simp only [Finset.mem_Iic] at hi
                  have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
                  subst i
                  simp only [Learning.rewardByCount_zero, hω, ↓reduceIte])
    · have he : {ω : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)} = ∅ := by
        ext ω
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        intro hz
        have hz0 : Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = 0 := by simpa using hz
        rw [Learning.stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff] at hz0
        omega
      rw [he]
      simp only [Measure.restrict_empty, Measure.map_zero, Measure.prod_zero]
  · have hkpos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
    have hbase_meas : Measurable (fun ω : Ω ↦
        (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω, A k ω)) :=
      (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.measurable_hist h.measurable_A h.measurable_R (k - 1)).prodMk
        (h.measurable_A k)
    have hC_meas : Measurable (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
        ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) :=
      (hbase_meas.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
    have hcd0 := HasCondDistrib.fst_prod_pair
      (h.measurable_R ((k - 1) + 1))
      ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.measurable_hist h.measurable_A h.measurable_R (k - 1)).prodMk
        (h.measurable_A ((k - 1) + 1)))
      (h.hasCondDistrib_reward (k - 1))
      (σ := Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)
    have hcd : ProbabilityTheory.HasCondDistrib
        (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦ R k p.1)
        (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
          ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2))
        (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight (ℕ → α → ℝ)
          ((Learning.stationaryEnv ν).feedback (k - 1)))
        (P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hkpos] using hcd0
    have he_comap : MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap
        (fun ω : Ω ↦ (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω, A k ω)) inferInstance]
        {ω : Ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω = (k : ℕ∞)} :=
      Learning.measurableSet_stepsUntil_eq h.measurable_A h.measurable_R a (n + 1) k
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hs_pre⟩ := (MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap).mp he_comap
    let s' : Set ((↥(Finset.Iic (k - 1)) → α × ℝ) × α) := s ∩ {p | p.2 = a}
    have hs' : MeasurableSet s' :=
      hs.inter ((measurableSet_singleton a).preimage measurable_snd)
    have hs'_pre : (fun ω : Ω ↦
          (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω, A k ω)) ⁻¹' s' =
        {ω : Ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω = (k : ℕ∞)} := by
      ext ω
      constructor
      · intro hω
        exact Set.ext_iff.mp hs_pre ω |>.mp hω.1
      · intro hω
        refine ⟨Set.ext_iff.mp hs_pre ω |>.mpr hω, ?_⟩
        exact Learning.action_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe (by omega) hω
    let t : Set ((((↥(Finset.Iic (k - 1)) → α × ℝ) × α) × (ℕ → α → ℝ))) :=
      Prod.fst ⁻¹' s'
    have ht : MeasurableSet t := hs'.preimage measurable_fst
    have ht_pre : (fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
          ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) ⁻¹' t =
        {ω : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = (k : ℕ∞)} := by
      ext ω
      change (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1) ∈ s' ↔ _
      exact Set.ext_iff.mp hs'_pre ω.1
    have hκ : ∀ p ∈ t,
        ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight (ℕ → α → ℝ)
            ((Learning.stationaryEnv ν).feedback (k - 1)) p = ν a := by
      intro p hp
      change p.1 ∈ s' at hp
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkRight_apply]
      simp only [Learning.stationaryEnv_feedback,
        ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft_apply]
      exact congrArg ν hp.2
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfibre⟩ := rewardByCount_Iic_factor_on_finite_fiber
      h.measurable_A h.measurable_R a n k hk
    have hres := HasCondDistrib.restrict_factorization_of_const
      ((h.measurable_R k).comp measurable_fst) hC_meas hcd ht hκ f hf
    have hevent : MeasurableSet
        ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
          ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) ⁻¹' t) :=
      ht.preimage hC_meas
    rw [← ht_pre]
    calc
      Measure.map
          (fun ω ↦
            (Learning.rewardByCount A R a (n + 1) ω,
              fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic n) ↦ Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω))
          ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
            ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
              ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) ⁻¹' t)) =
        Measure.map
          (fun ω ↦
            (R k ω.1,
              f ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1), ω.2)))
          ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
            ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
              ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) ⁻¹' t)) := by
            apply Measure.map_congr
            exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hevent (fun ω hω ↦ by
              have hstep : Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = (k : ℕ∞) := by
                rw [ht_pre] at hω
                exact hω
              apply Prod.ext
              · exact Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hstep
              · exact hfibre ω hstep)
      _ = (ν a).prod
          (Measure.map
            (fun ω ↦
              f ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) ω.1, A k ω.1), ω.2))
            ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
              ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
                ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) ⁻¹' t))) := hres
      _ = (ν a).prod
          (Measure.map
            (fun ω ↦ fun i : ↥(Finset.Iic n) ↦
              Learning.rewardByCount A R a (i : ℕ) ω)
            ((P.prod (Bandits.Bandit.streamMeasure ν)).restrict
              ((fun p : Ω × (ℕ → α → ℝ) ↦
                ((Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hist A R (k - 1) p.1, A k p.1), p.2)) ⁻¹' t))) := by
            congr 1
            apply Measure.map_congr
            exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hevent (fun ω hω ↦ by
              have hstep : Learning.stepsUntil A a (n + 1) ω.1 = (k : ℕ∞) := by
                rw [ht_pre] at hω
                exact hω

      constructor
      · rintro (h | ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩)
        · exact List.sublist_cons_of_sublist x h
        · exact List.Sublist.cons_cons x ht

theorem lis_fold_generation_invariant{α : Type} (xs : List α) (acc : List (List α)) (r : List α) :
  r ∈ List.foldl
      (fun (a : List (List α)) (x : α) => a ++ a.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) acc xs ↔
    ∃ b, b ∈ acc ∧ ∃ t, List.Sublist t xs ∧ r = t.reverse ++ b := by
  induction xs generalizing acc r with
  | nil =>
    constructor
    · intro hr
      refine ⟨r, hr, [], List.Sublist.refl [], ?_⟩
      simp only [List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append]
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, t, ht, rfl⟩
      have ht0 : t = [] := List.sublist_nil.mp ht
      subst t
      simpa only [List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append] using hb
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, t, ht, hr⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hb with hb | hb
      · exact ⟨b, hb, t, ht.cons x, hr⟩
      · rcases List.mem_map.mp hb with ⟨b0, hb0, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨b0, hb0, x :: t, ht.cons₂ x, ?_⟩
        simpa only [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hr
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, t, ht, hr⟩
      cases ht with
      | cons a ht =>
          exact ⟨b, List.mem_append_left _ hb, t, ht, hr⟩
      | cons₂ a ht =>
          refine ⟨x :: b, List.mem_append_right _ ?_, _, ht, ?_⟩
          · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
          · simpa only [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hr

theorem lis_fold_generated_reverse_mem_iff{α : Type} (xs s : List α) :
  s.reverse ∈ List.foldl
      (fun (a : List (List α)) (x : α) => a ++ a.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] xs ↔
    s ∈ subsequences xs := by
  rw [lis_fold_generation_invariant xs [[]] s.reverse]
  rw [lis_subsequences_mem_iff_sublist]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, t, ht, hrev⟩
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
    subst b
    simp only [List.append_nil] at hrev
    have : s = t := by
      apply List.reverse_injective
      simpa only [List.reverse_reverse] using hrev
    simpa only [this] using ht
  · intro hs
    refine ⟨[], ?_, s, hs, ?_⟩
    · simp only [List.mem_singleton]
    · simp only [List.append_nil]

theorem lis_isStrictlyIncreasing_iff_pairwise(s : List ℤ) :
  isStrictlyIncreasing s = true ↔ List.Pairwise (fun a b : ℤ => a < b) s := by
  induction s with
  | nil =>
      simp [isStrictlyIncreasing]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
          simp [isStrictlyIncreasing]
      | cons y ys =>
          simp [isStrictlyIncreasing] at ih ⊢
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hxy, htail⟩
            rcases ih.mp htail with ⟨hyall, hpw⟩
            exact ⟨⟨hxy, fun z hz => by
              have hyz := hyall z hz
              omega⟩, hyall, hpw⟩
          · rintro ⟨⟨hxy, hxall⟩, hyall, hpw⟩
            exact ⟨hxy, ih.mpr ⟨hyall, hpw⟩⟩

theorem lis_foldl_max_lengths_invariant(ls : List (List ℤ)) (acc : ℕ) :
  acc ≤ List.foldl (fun a s => Nat.max a s.length) acc ls ∧
  (∀ s, s ∈ ls → s.length ≤ List.foldl (fun a s => Nat.max a s.length) acc ls) ∧
  (List.foldl (fun a s => Nat.max a s.length) acc ls = acc ∨
    ∃ s, s ∈ ls ∧ s.length = List.foldl (fun a s => Nat.max a s.length) acc ls) := by
  induction ls generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
      constructor
      · exact le_rfl
      · constructor
        · intro s hs
          cases hs
        · exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons s tail ih =>
      have hIH := ih (Nat.max acc s.length)
      rcases hIH with ⟨hlower, hall, hattain⟩
      constructor
      · exact le_trans (Nat.le_max_left acc s.length) hlower
      · constructor
        · intro t ht
          simp only [List.mem_cons] at ht
          rcases ht with hts | ht
          · subst t
            exact le_trans (Nat.le_max_right acc s.length) hlower
          · exact hall t ht
        · rcases hattain with heq | ⟨t, ht, heq⟩
          · by_cases h : acc ≤ s.length
            · right
              refine ⟨s, List.mem_cons_self s tail, ?_⟩
              calc
                s.length = Nat.max acc s.length := (Nat.max_eq_right h).symm
                _ = List.foldl (fun a s => Nat.max a s.length) acc (s :: tail) := heq.symm
            · left
              calc
                List.foldl (fun a s => Nat.max a s.length) acc (s :: tail) = Nat.max acc s.length := heq
                _ = acc := Nat.max_eq_left (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h))
          · right
            exact ⟨t, List.mem_cons_of_mem s ht, heq⟩

theorem lis_foldl_max_lengths_spec(ls : List (List ℤ)) (hnil : ([] : List ℤ) ∈ ls) :
  (∃ s, s ∈ ls ∧ s.length = List.foldl (fun a t => Nat.max a t.length) 0 ls) ∧
  ∀ s, s ∈ ls → s.length ≤ List.foldl (fun a t => Nat.max a t.length) 0 ls := by
  rcases lis_foldl_max_lengths_invariant ls 0 with ⟨hacc, hbound, hattain⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hbound⟩
  rcases hattain with hzero | ⟨s, hmem, hlen⟩
  · exact ⟨[], hnil, by simpa only [List.length_nil] using hzero.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨s, hmem, hlen⟩

def maxStrength_recursiveSelect : List Int → Nat → List Int
  | [], _ => []
  | x :: xs, mask =>
      if mask.land 1 == 1 then
        x :: maxStrength_recursiveSelect xs (mask.shiftRight 1)
      else
        maxStrength_recursiveSelect xs (mask.shiftRight 1)

def maxStrength_maskPowerSet (nums : List Int) : List (List Int) :=
  (List.range (2 ^ nums.length)).map (maxStrength_maskSelect nums)

def maxStrength_sublistProducts (nums : List Int) : List Int :=
  List.map (List.foldl (· * ·) 1) (nums.sublists.filter (· ≠ []))

theorem maxStrength_maskSelect_eq_recursive(nums : List Int) (mask : Nat) :
  maxStrength_maskSelect nums mask = maxStrength_recursiveSelect nums mask := by
  induction nums generalizing mask with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      unfold maxStrength_maskSelect maxStrength_recursiveSelect
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      rw [List.range_succ_eq_map]
      simp only [List.foldr_cons, List.foldr_map, Function.comp_apply]
      have htail :
          List.foldr
              (fun i acc =>
                if (mask.shiftRight i.succ).land 1 == 1 then
                  (x :: xs)[i.succ]! :: acc
                else acc)
              [] (List.range xs.length) =
            maxStrength_maskSelect xs (mask.shiftRight 1) := by
        unfold maxStrength_maskSelect
        apply List.foldr_ext
        intro i hi acc
        have hs : mask.shiftRight i.succ =
            (mask.shiftRight 1).shiftRight i := by
          simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.shiftRight_eq]
          rw [Nat.add_comm i 1, Nat.shiftRight_add]
        rw [hs]
        rfl
      rw [htail, ih]
      rfl

theorem maxStrength_recursiveSelect_sublist(nums : List Int) (mask : Nat) :
  List.Sublist (maxStrength_recursiveSelect nums mask) nums := by
  induction nums generalizing mask with
  | nil =>
      exact List.Sublist.refl []
  | cons x xs ih =>
      unfold maxStrength_recursiveSelect
      split
      · exact List.Sublist.cons₂ x (ih (mask.shiftRight 1))
      · exact List.sublist_cons_of_sublist x (ih (mask.shiftRight 1))

theorem maxStrength_recursiveSelect_encode(nums sub : List Int) (h : List.Sublist sub nums) :
  ∃ mask, mask < 2 ^ nums.length ∧ maxStrength_recursiveSelect nums mask = sub := by
  induction h with
  | slnil =>
      exact ⟨0, by norm_num, rfl⟩
  | @cons l₁ l₂ a h ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨m, hm, hsel⟩
      refine ⟨Nat.bit false m, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [List.length_cons] using (Nat.bit_lt_two_pow_succ_iff.mpr hm)
      · have hland : (Nat.bit false m).land 1 = 0 := by
          change Nat.bit false m &&& 1 = 0
          rw [Nat.and_one_is_mod, Nat.bit_mod_two]
          rfl
        have hshift : (Nat.bit false m).shiftRight 1 = m := by
          change Nat.bit false m >>> 1 = m
          exact Nat.bit_shiftRight_one false m
        rw [maxStrength_recursiveSelect, hland, hshift, hsel]
        norm_num
  | @cons₂ l₁ l₂ a h ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨m, hm, hsel⟩
      refine ⟨Nat.bit true m, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [List.length_cons] using (Nat.bit_lt_two_pow_succ_iff.mpr hm)
      · have hland : (Nat.bit true m).land 1 = 1 := by
          change Nat.bit true m &&& 1 = 1
          rw [Nat.and_one_is_mod, Nat.bit_mod_two]
          rfl
        have hshift : (Nat.bit true m).shiftRight 1 = m := by
          change Nat.bit true m >>> 1 = m
          exact Nat.bit_shiftRight_one true m
        rw [maxStrength_recursiveSelect, hland, hshift, hsel]
        norm_num

theorem maxStrength_recursiveSelect_exists_iff_sublist(nums sub : List Int) :
  (∃ mask, mask < 2 ^ nums.length ∧ maxStrength_recursiveSelect nums mask = sub) ↔
    List.Sublist sub nums := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨mask, _hbound, hsel⟩
    rw [← hsel]
    exact maxStrength_recursiveSelect_sublist nums mask
  · intro hsub
    exact maxStrength_recursiveSelect_encode nums sub hsub

theorem maxStrength_maskPowerSet_mem_iff_sublists(nums sub : List Int) :
  sub ∈ maxStrength_maskPowerSet nums ↔ sub ∈ nums.sublists := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold maxStrength_maskPowerSet at h
    rcases List.mem_map.mp h with ⟨mask, hmask, hselect⟩
    have hlt : mask < 2 ^ nums.length := List.mem_range.mp hmask
    have hex : ∃ mask, mask < 2 ^ nums.length ∧

    have hsub : List.Sublist sub nums :=

    exact List.mem_sublists.mpr hsub
  · intro h
    have hsub : List.Sublist sub nums := List.mem_sublists.mp h
    rcases (maxStrength_recursiveSelect_exists_iff_sublist nums sub).mpr hsub with
      ⟨mask, hlt, hselect⟩
    unfold maxStrength_maskPowerSet
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨mask, List.mem_range.mpr hlt, ?_⟩
    rw [maxStrength_maskSelect_eq_recursive]
    exact hselect

theorem maxStrength_maskProducts_mem_iff_sublistProducts(nums : List Int) (value : Int) :
  value ∈ maxStrength_maskProducts nums ↔ value ∈ maxStrength_sublistProducts nums := by
  unfold maxStrength_maskProducts maxStrength_sublistProducts
  constructor

    rcases List.mem_filter.mp hsub with ⟨hsub_mem, hsub_ne⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr

    apply List.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨(maxStrength_maskPowerSet_mem_iff_sublists nums sub).mp hsub_mem, hsub_ne⟩
  · intro h
    rcases List.mem_map.mp h with ⟨sub, hsub, rfl⟩
    rcases List.mem_filter.mp hsub with ⟨hsub_mem, hsub_ne⟩
    apply List.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨sub, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply List.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨(maxStrength_maskPowerSet_mem_iff_sublists nums sub).mpr hsub_mem, hsub_ne⟩

theorem maxStrength_maskProducts_nonempty(nums : List Int) (h : maxStrength_precond nums) :
  maxStrength_maskProducts nums ≠ [] := by

def lisA_subseqLengths (numbers : List Int) : List Nat :=
  (numbers.sublists.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· < ·) l)).map List.length
def lisA_listMax (xs : List Nat) : Nat := xs.foldr Nat.max 0

def lisA_eligibleLengths (curr : Int) (prevNums : List Int) (lengths : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  (prevNums.zip lengths).filterMap (fun p => if p.1 < curr then some p.2 else none)

def lisA_findMax : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs =>
      let maxRest := lisA_findMax xs
      if x > maxRest then x else maxRest

def lisA_findPrev (curr : Int) : List Int → List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], _, best => best
  | prevVal :: restVals, prevLen :: restLens, best =>
      if prevVal < curr then
        lisA_findPrev curr restVals restLens (max best prevLen)
      else
        lisA_findPrev curr restVals restLens best
  | _, _, best => best

def lisA_build : List Int → List Int → List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], _, lengths, _ => lisA_findMax lengths
  | currNum :: restNums, prevNums, lengths, idx =>
      let bestPrevLen := lisA_findPrev currNum prevNums lengths 0
      let currLength := bestPrevLen + 1
      lisA_build restNums (prevNums ++ [currNum]) (lengths ++ [currLength]) (idx + 1)

theorem lisA_generated_subseqs_eq_sublists(numbers : List Int) :
  ((numbers.foldl (fun acc x => acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]]).map List.reverse) = numbers.sublists := by
  induction numbers using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rfl
  | append_singleton xs x ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_append]
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, List.map_append, List.map_map,
        Function.comp_apply]
      rw [List.sublists_concat, ← ih, List.map_map]
      congr 2
      funext sub
      exact List.reverse_cons x sub

theorem lisA_subseqLengths_zero_mem(numbers : List Int) : 0 ∈ lisA_subseqLengths numbers := by
  unfold lisA_subseqLengths
  apply List.mem_map.mpr
  refine ⟨[], ?_, rfl⟩
  apply List.mem_filter.mpr
  exact ⟨List.mem_sublists.mpr (List.nil_sublist numbers), rfl⟩

theorem lisA_listMax_spec(xs : List Nat) (hzero : 0 ∈ xs) :
  lisA_listMax xs ∈ xs ∧ ∀ k ∈ xs, k ≤ lisA_listMax xs := by
  unfold lisA_listMax
  have hspec : ∀ ys : List Nat,
      (ys.foldr Nat.max 0 = 0 ∨ ys.foldr Nat.max 0 ∈ ys) ∧
        ∀ k ∈ ys, k ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0 := by
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil =>
        constructor
        · left
          rfl
        · intro k hk
          cases hk
    | cons a ys ih =>
        constructor
        · rcases ih.1 with htail0 | htailmem
          · by_cases hale : a ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0
            · left
              change (if a ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0 then ys.foldr Nat.max 0 else a) = 0
              rw [if_pos hale, htail0]
            · right
              change (if a ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0 then ys.foldr Nat.max 0 else a) ∈ a :: ys
              rw [if_neg hale]
              exact List.mem_cons_self a ys
          · by_cases hale : a ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0
            · right
              change (if a ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0 then ys.foldr Nat.max 0 else a) ∈ a :: ys
              rw [if_pos hale]
              exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a htailmem
            · right
              change (if a ≤ ys.foldr Nat.max 0 then ys.foldr Nat.max 0 else a) ∈ a :: ys
              rw [if_neg hale]
              exact List.mem_cons_self a ys
        · intro k hk
          rw [List.foldr]
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hk with rfl | hk
          · exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
          · exact le_trans (ih.2 k hk) (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
  rcases hspec xs with ⟨hmem, hbound⟩
  constructor
  · rcases hmem with hmax0 | hmaxmem
    · rw [hmax0]
      exact hzero
    · exact hmaxmem
  · exact hbound

theorem lisA_findMax_eq(xs : List Nat) : lisA_findMax xs = lisA_listMax xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      change (if x > lisA_findMax xs then x else lisA_findMax xs) = Nat.max x (lisA_listMax xs)
      rw [ih]
      by_cases h : x > lisA_listMax xs
      · rw [if_pos h]
        exact (Nat.max_eq_left (by omega)).symm
      · rw [if_neg h]
        exact (Nat.max_eq_right (by omega)).symm

theorem lisA_findPrev_eq(curr : Int) (prevNums : List Int) (lengths : List Nat) (best : Nat) :
  lisA_findPrev curr prevNums lengths best =
    Nat.max best (lisA_listMax (lisA_eligibleLengths curr prevNums lengths)) := by
  induction prevNums generalizing lengths best with
  | nil =>
      simp [lisA_findPrev, lisA_eligibleLengths, lisA_listMax]
  | cons prevVal restVals ih =>
      cases lengths with
      | nil =>
          simp [lisA_findPrev, lisA_eligibleLengths, lisA_listMax]
      | cons prevLen restLens =>
          by_cases h : prevVal < curr
          · simp [lisA_findPrev, lisA_eligibleLengths, lisA_listMax, h, ih,
              Nat.max_assoc, Nat.max_comm, Nat.max_left_comm]
          · simp [lisA_findPrev, lisA_eligibleLengths, lisA_listMax, h, ih]

theorem lisA_local_findMax_eq(xs : List Nat) :
  longestIncreasingSubsequence.buildTables.findMaxLength xs = lisA_findMax xs := by
  induction xs with

      (List.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) c l = c ∨
        List.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) c l ∈ l) ∧
      c ≤ List.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) c l ∧
      ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ List.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) c l := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro c
        constructor
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · constructor
          · exact Nat.le_refl c
          · intro x hx
            simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hx
    | cons a l ih =>
        intro c
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        by_cases hca : c ≥ a
        · simp only [hca, ↓reduceIte]
          rcases ih c with ⟨hchoice, hbound, hall⟩
          refine ⟨?_, hbound, ?_⟩
          · rcases hchoice with hresult | hmem
            · exact Or.inl hresult
            · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hmem)
          · intro x hx
            simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
            rcases hx with rfl | hx
            · omega
            · exact hall x hx
        · simp only [hca, ↓reduceIte]
          rcases ih a with ⟨hchoice, hbound, hall⟩
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rcases hchoice with hresult | hmem
            · exact Or.inr (hresult.symm ▸ List.mem_cons_self a l)
            · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hmem)
          · omega
          · intro x hx
            simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
            rcases hx with rfl | hx
            · exact hbound
            · exact hall x hx
  rcases aux arr.toList 0 with ⟨hchoice, hbound, hall⟩
  rw [Array.foldl_toList] at hchoice hall
  constructor
  · cases hlist : arr.toList with
    | nil =>
        left
        rw [Array.size_eq_length_toList, hlist]
        rfl
    | cons a l =>
        right
        rcases hchoice with hzero | hmem
        · have ha : a ≤ arr.foldl (fun a b => if a ≥ b then a else b) 0 :=
            hall a (by rw [hlist]; exact List.mem_cons_self a l)
          have ha0 : a = 0 := by omega
          rw [hzero, ha0]
          exact List.mem_cons_self 0 l
        · simpa only [hlist] using hmem
  · exact hall

def lisProof_endSpec (nums : List ℤ) (i : Fin nums.length) (d : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ is : List (Fin nums.length),
    lisProof_indexSubseq nums is ∧
    is.getLast? = some i ∧
    is.length = d) ∧
  ∀ is : List (Fin nums.length),
    lisProof_indexSubseq nums is →
    is.getLast? = some i →
    is.length ≤ d

def lisProof_prefixInvariant (nums : List ℤ) (upto : Nat) (dp : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  dp.size = nums.length ∧
  (∀ i, i < upto → ∀ hi : i < nums.length,
    lisProof_endSpec nums ⟨i, hi⟩ dp[i]!) ∧
  ∀ i, upto ≤ i → i < nums.length → dp[i]! = 1

theorem lisProof_innerStep_size(nums : List ℤ) (i j : Nat) (dp : Array Nat) :
  (lisProof_innerStep nums i dp j).size = dp.size := by
  unfold lisProof_innerStep
  split
  · rw [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds]
    exact Array.size_setIfInBounds _ _ _
  · rfl

theorem lisProof_outerStep_size(nums : List ℤ) (i : Nat) (dp : Array Nat) :
  (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i).size = dp.size := by
  unfold lisProof_outerStep
  generalize hjs : List.range' 0 i 1 = js
  clear hjs
  induction js generalizing dp with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons j js ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [ih]
      exact lisProof_innerStep_size nums i j dp

theorem lisProof_dpArray_size(nums : List ℤ) : (lisProof_dpArray nums).size = nums.length := by
  unfold lisProof_dpArray
  generalize List.range' 1 (nums.length - 1) 1 = is
  have hfold : ∀ (dp : Array Nat), dp.size = nums.length →
      (is.foldl (lisProof_outerStep nums) dp).size = nums.length := by
    intro dp hdp
    induction is generalizing dp with
    | nil =>
        exact hdp
    | cons i is ih =>
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        apply ih
        rw [lisProof_outerStep_size]
        exact hdp
  apply hfold
  exact Array.size_mkArray nums.length 1

theorem lisProof_indexSubseq_singleton(nums : List ℤ) (i : Fin nums.length) :
  lisProof_indexSubseq nums [i] := by
  unfold lisProof_indexSubseq
  simp only [List.pairwise_singleton, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
  exact ⟨True.intro, True.intro⟩

theorem lisProof_indexSubseq_append(nums : List ℤ) (is : List (Fin nums.length)) (j i : Fin nums.length)
  (hseq : lisProof_indexSubseq nums is)
  (hlast : is.getLast? = some j) (hji : j < i)
  (hval : nums.get j < nums.get i) :
  lisProof_indexSubseq nums (is ++ [i]) ∧
  (is ++ [i]).getLast? = some i ∧
  (is ++ [i]).length = is.length + 1 := by
  unfold lisProof_indexSubseq at hseq ⊢
  rcases hseq with ⟨hidx, hvals⟩
  have hj_lastmem : j ∈ is.getLast? := by
    rw [hlast]
    simp only [Option.mem_def]
  have his_eq : is.dropLast ++ [j] = is :=
    List.dropLast_append_getLast? j hj_lastmem
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]⟩
  · constructor
    · rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨hidx, by simp only [List.pairwise_singleton], ?_⟩
      intro k hk b hb
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
      subst b
      have hidx' := hidx
      rw [← his_eq, List.pairwise_append] at hidx'
      rcases hidx' with ⟨_, _, hcross⟩
      rw [← his_eq] at hk
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hk
      rcases hk with hk | rfl
      · have hkj : k < j := hcross k hk j (by simp only [List.mem_singleton])
        omega
      · exact hji
    · rw [List.map_append, List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨hvals, by simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.pairwise_singleton], ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.mem_singleton] at hy
      subst y
      have hvals' := hvals
      rw [← his_eq, List.map_append, List.pairwise_append] at hvals'
      rcases hvals' with ⟨_, _, hcross⟩
      rw [← his_eq, List.map_append] at hx
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | rfl
      · have hxj : x < nums.get j :=
          hcross x hx (nums.get j) (by simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.mem_singleton])
        omega
      · exact hval
  · rw [List.getLast?_append]
    rfl

theorem lisProof_indexSubseq_predecessor(nums : List ℤ) (is : List (Fin nums.length)) (i : Fin nums.length)
  (hseq : lisProof_indexSubseq nums is)
  (hlast : is.getLast? = some i) (hlen : 1 < is.length) :
  ∃ pre : List (Fin nums.length), ∃ j : Fin nums.length,
    is = pre ++ [i] ∧
    pre.getLast? = some j ∧
    lisProof_indexSubseq nums pre ∧
    j < i ∧ nums.get j < nums.get i := by
  have pairwise_append_singleton :
      ∀ {α : Type} {R : α → α → Prop} (l : List α) (a : α),
        (l ++ [a]).Pairwise R →
          l.Pairwise R ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, R x a := by
    intro α R l a h
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        constructor
        · exact List.Pairwise.nil
        · intro x hx
          exact (List.not_mem_nil x hx).elim
    | cons b l ih =>
        rw [List.cons_append, List.pairwise_cons] at h
        rcases h with ⟨hb, htail⟩
        rcases ih htail with ⟨hl, hlast⟩
        constructor
        · rw [List.pairwise_cons]
          exact ⟨fun x hx => hb x (by simp only [List.mem_append, hx, true_or]), hl⟩
        · intro x hx
          rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
          rcases hx with rfl | hx
          · exact hb a (by simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, or_true])
          · exact hlast x hx
  revert i
  induction is using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      intro i hlast
      simp only [List.getLast?_nil] at hlast
      cases hlast
  | append_singleton pre x ih =>
      intro i hlast
      rw [List.getLast?_append_cons] at hlast
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hlast
      subst x
      induction pre using List.reverseRecOn with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append, List.length_singleton] at hlen
          omega
      | append_singleton pre0 j ihpre =>
          unfold lisProof_indexSubseq at hseq ⊢
          rcases hseq with ⟨hidx, hval⟩
          have hidx' := pairwise_append_singleton (pre0 ++ [j]) i hidx
          have hvalfull :
              ((pre0 ++ [j]).map nums.get ++ [nums.get i]).Pairwise (· < ·) := by
            simpa only [List.map_append, List.map_singleton] using hval
          have hval' := pairwise_append_singleton ((pre0 ++ [j]).map nums.get) (nums.get i) hvalfull
          refine ⟨pre0 ++ [j], j, rfl, ?_, ⟨hidx'.1, hval'.1⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [List.getLast?_append_cons]
            rfl
          · exact hidx'.2 j (by simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, or_true])
          · exact hval'.2 (nums.get j) (List.mem_map_of_mem nums.get
              (by simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, or_true]))

theorem lisProof_index_to_sublists(nums : List ℤ) (is : List (Fin nums.length))
  (hseq : lisProof_indexSubseq nums is) :
  (is.map nums.get) ∈ nums.sublists ∧
  (is.map nums.get).Pairwise (· < ·) := by
  rcases hseq with ⟨hidx, hval⟩
  refine ⟨List.mem_sublists.mpr ?_, hval⟩
  rw [List.sublist_iff_exists_fin_orderEmbedding_get_eq]
  let castFin : Fin (is.map nums.get).length → Fin is.length := fun ix =>
    ⟨ix.val, by simpa only [List.length_map] using ix.isLt⟩
  have hcast : StrictMono castFin := by
    intro a b hab
    exact hab
  refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono (fun ix => is.get (castFin ix))
    ((List.Sorted.get_strictMono hidx).comp hcast), ?_⟩
  intro ix
  cases ix with
  | mk i hi =>
      simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, castFin]
      rw [← List.getElem_map_rev]
      rfl

theorem lisProof_sublists_to_index(nums s : List ℤ) (hs : s ∈ nums.sublists)
  (hinc : s.Pairwise (· < ·)) :
  ∃ is : List (Fin nums.length),
    lisProof_indexSubseq nums is ∧
    is.map nums.get = s := by
  have hsub : List.Sublist s nums := List.mem_sublists.mp hs
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.sublist_iff_exists_fin_orderEmbedding_get_eq.mp hsub
  let is : List (Fin nums.length) := List.ofFn f
  have hmap : is.map nums.get = s := by
    dsimp [is]
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    calc
      List.ofFn (nums.get ∘ f) = List.ofFn s.get := by
        apply congrArg List.ofFn
        funext i
        exact (hf i).symm
      _ = s := List.ofFn_get s
  refine ⟨is, ?_, hmap⟩
  constructor
  · dsimp [is]
    rw [List.pairwise_ofFn]
    intro i j hij
    exact f.lt_iff_lt.mpr hij
  · rw [hmap]
    exact hinc

theorem lisProof_innerFold_numeric(nums : List ℤ) (i : Nat) (dp : Array Nat) (js : List Nat)
  (hi : i < dp.size) (hbase : dp[i]! = 1)
  (hjs : ∀ j ∈ js, j ≠ i) :
  (js.foldl (lisProof_innerStep nums i) dp).size = dp.size ∧
  (∀ k, k ≠ i → (js.foldl (lisProof_innerStep nums i) dp)[k]! = dp[k]!) ∧
  ((js.foldl (lisProof_innerStep nums i) dp)[i]! = 1 ∨
    ∃ j ∈ js, nums[j]! < nums[i]! ∧
      (js.foldl (lisProof_innerStep nums i) dp)[i]! = dp[j]! + 1) ∧
  ∀ j ∈ js, nums[j]! < nums[i]! →
    dp[j]! + 1 ≤ (js.foldl (lisProof_innerStep nums i) dp)[i]! := by
  classical
  induction js using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, Or.inl hbase,
        fun j hj => (List.not_mem_nil j hj).elim⟩
  | append_singleton js j ih =>
      have hjs' : ∀ k ∈ js, k ≠ i := by
        intro k hk
        exact hjs k (List.mem_append_left [j] hk)
      obtain ⟨hsize, hne, hwit, hdom⟩ := ih hjs'
      have hjmem : j ∈ js ++ [j] := List.mem_append_right js (by simp only [List.mem_singleton])
      have hjne : j ≠ i := hjs j hjmem
      simp only [List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
      let prev := List.foldl (lisProof_innerStep nums i) dp js
      change (lisProof_innerStep nums i prev j).size = dp.size ∧
        (∀ k, k ≠ i → (lisProof_innerStep nums i prev j)[k]! = dp[k]!) ∧
        ((lisProof_innerStep nums i prev j)[i]! = 1 ∨
          ∃ k ∈ js ++ [j], nums[k]! < nums[i]! ∧
            (lisProof_innerStep nums i prev j)[i]! = dp[k]! + 1) ∧
        ∀ k ∈ js ++ [j], nums[k]! < nums[i]! →
          dp[k]! + 1 ≤ (lisProof_innerStep nums i prev j)[i]!
      change prev.size = dp.size at hsize
      change ∀ k, k ≠ i → prev[k]! = dp[k]! at hne
      change (prev[i]! = 1 ∨ ∃ k ∈ js, nums[k]! < nums[i]! ∧ prev[i]! = dp[k]! + 1) at hwit
      change ∀ k ∈ js, nums[k]! < nums[i]! → dp[k]! + 1 ≤ prev[i]! at hdom
      have hprevj : prev[j]! = dp[j]! := hne j hjne
      have hiprev : i < prev.size := by omega
      have hwit_append : prev[i]! = 1 ∨
          ∃ k ∈ js ++ [j], nums[k]! < nums[i]! ∧ prev[i]! = dp[k]! + 1 := by
        rcases hwit with hwit | ⟨k, hk, hltk, heq⟩
        · exact Or.inl hwit
        · exact Or.inr ⟨k, List.mem_append_left [j] hk, hltk, heq⟩
      by_cases hlt : nums[j]! < nums[i]!
      · by_cases hup : dp[j]! + 1 > prev[i]!
        · simp only [lisProof_innerStep, hlt, hprevj, hup, decide_true, Bool.true_and, if_true]
          have hsetself : (prev.set! i (dp[j]! + 1))[i]! = dp[j]! + 1 := by
            rw [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.getElem!_eq_getD,
              Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getD_get?_setIfInBounds, if_pos hiprev]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa only [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.size_setIfInBounds] using hsize
          · intro k hk
            calc
              (prev.set! i (dp[j]! + 1))[k]! = prev[k]! := by
                rw [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.getElem!_eq_getD,
                  Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds_ne (Ne.symm hk)]
                symm
                rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?]
              _ = dp[k]! := hne k hk
          · exact Or.inr ⟨j, hjmem, hlt, hsetself⟩
          · intro k hk hltk
            rw [hsetself]
            rw [List.mem_append] at hk
            rcases hk with hk | hk
            · have hle := hdom k hk hltk
              omega
            · have hkj : k = j := by simpa only [List.mem_singleton] using hk
              subst k
              exact Nat.le_refl _
        · simp only [lisProof_innerStep, hlt, hprevj, hup, decide_true, Bool.true_and,
            decide_false, Bool.and_false, if_false]
          refine ⟨hsize, hne, hwit_append, ?_⟩
          intro k hk hltk
          rw [List.mem_append] at hk
          rcases hk with hk | hk
          · exact hdom k hk hltk
          · have hkj : k = j := by simpa only [List.mem_singleton] using hk
            subst k
            exact Nat.le_of_not_gt hup
      · simp only [lisProof_innerStep, hlt, decide_false, Bool.false_and, if_false]
        refine ⟨hsize, hne, hwit_append, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hltk
        rw [List.mem_append] at hk
        rcases hk with hk | hk
        · exact hdom k hk hltk
        · have hkj : k = j := by simpa only [List.mem_singleton] using hk
          subst k
          exact (hlt hltk).elim

theorem lisProof_outerStep_numeric(nums : List ℤ) (i : Nat) (dp : Array Nat)
  (hi : i < dp.size) (hbase : dp[i]! = 1) :
  (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i).size = dp.size ∧
  (∀ k, k ≠ i → (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i)[k]! = dp[k]!) ∧
  ((lisProof_outerStep nums dp i)[i]! = 1 ∨
    ∃ j, j < i ∧ nums[j]! < nums[i]! ∧
      (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i)[i]! = dp[j]! + 1) ∧
  ∀ j, j < i → nums[j]! < nums[i]! →
    dp[j]! + 1 ≤ (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i)[i]! := by
  unfold lisProof_outerStep
  have hjs : ∀ j ∈ List.range' 0 i 1, j ≠ i := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [List.mem_range'] at hj
    omega
  rcases lisProof_innerFold_numeric nums i dp (List.range' 0 i 1) hi hbase hjs with
    ⟨hsize, hunch, hform, hdom⟩
  refine ⟨hsize, hunch, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hform with hbase' | ⟨j, hj, hlt, heq⟩
    · exact Or.inl hbase'
    · refine Or.inr ⟨j, ?_, hlt, heq⟩
      simp only [List.mem_range'] at hj
      omega
  · intro j hj hlt
    apply hdom j
    · simp only [List.mem_range']
      exact ⟨j, hj, by omega⟩
    · exact hlt

theorem lisProof_initial_invariant(nums : List ℤ) (hne : nums ≠ []) :
  lisProof_prefixInvariant nums 1 (Array.mkArray nums.length 1) := by
  cases nums with
  | nil =>
      exact (hne rfl).elim
  | cons x xs =>
      have hget (i : Nat) (hi : i < (x :: xs).length) :
          (Array.mkArray (x :: xs).length 1)[i]! = 1 := by
        rw [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getElem?_mkArray_of_lt hi]
        rfl
      unfold lisProof_prefixInvariant
      constructor
      · exact Array.size_mkArray _ _
      constructor
      · intro i hi hi'
        have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
        subst i
        have hget0 := hget 0 hi'
        unfold lisProof_endSpec
        constructor
        · refine ⟨[⟨0, hi'⟩], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact lisProof_indexSubseq_singleton (x :: xs) ⟨0, hi'⟩
          · simp only [List.getLast?_singleton]
          · simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add]
            exact hget0.symm
        · rw [hget0]
          intro is hseq hlast
          by_contra hle
          have hlen : 1 < is.length := by omega
          obtain ⟨pre, j, his, hprelast, hpreseq, hji, hval⟩ :=
            lisProof_indexSubseq_predecessor (x :: xs) is ⟨0, hi'⟩ hseq hlast hlen
          exact (Fin.not_lt_zero j) hji
      · intro i hi hi'
        exact hget i hi'

theorem lisProof_outerStep_invariant(nums : List ℤ) (i : Nat) (dp : Array Nat)
  (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (hin : i < nums.length)
  (hInv : lisProof_prefixInvariant nums i dp) :
  lisProof_prefixInvariant nums (i + 1) (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i) := by
  unfold lisProof_prefixInvariant at hInv ⊢
  rcases hInv with ⟨hsize, hprocessed, hunprocessed⟩
  have hbase : dp[i]! = 1 := hunprocessed i (by omega) hin
  have hidp : i < dp.size := by omega
  rcases lisProof_outerStep_numeric nums i dp hidp hbase with
    ⟨houtsize, hunchanged, hform, hdominates⟩
  have houtpos : 1 ≤ (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i)[i]! := by
    rcases hform with hEq | ⟨j, hj, hval, hEq⟩
    · omega
    · omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · intro k hk hkn
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      let hiFin : Fin nums.length := ⟨i, hkn⟩
      change lisProof_endSpec nums hiFin (lisProof_outerStep nums dp i)[i]!
      have hibang : nums[i]! = nums.get hiFin := by
        simp only [getElem!_def, getElem?_pos, hkn, ↓reduceIte, Option.getD_some]
        rfl
      constructor
      · rcases hform with hEq | ⟨j, hj, hval, hEq⟩
        · refine ⟨[hiFin], lisProof_indexSubseq_singleton nums hiFin, rfl, ?_⟩
          simpa only [List.length_singleton] using hEq.symm
        · have hjnums : j < nums.length := by omega
          have hjbang : nums[j]! = nums.get ⟨j, hjnums⟩ := by
            simp only [getElem!_def, getElem?_pos, hjnums, ↓reduceIte, Option.getD_some]
            rfl
          have hjSpec := hprocessed j hj hjnums
          rcases hjSpec.1 with ⟨is, hseq, hlast, hlen⟩
          have hval' : nums.get ⟨j, hjnums⟩ < nums.get hiFin := by
            rw [← hjbang, ← hibang]
            exact hval
          rcases lisProof_indexSubseq_append nums is ⟨j, hjnums⟩ hiFin hseq hlast
              (by exact hj) hval' with ⟨hseq', hlast', hlen'⟩
          refine ⟨is ++ [hiFin], hseq', hlast', ?_⟩
          omega
      · intro is hseq hlast
        by_cases hsmall : is.length ≤ 1
        · omega
        · have hlong : 1 < is.length := by omega
          rcases lisProof_indexSubseq_predecessor nums is hiFin hseq hlast hlong with
            ⟨pre, j, his, hprelast, hpreseq, hji, hval⟩
          have hjnums : (j : Nat) < nums.length := j.isLt
          have hjbang : nums[(j : Nat)]! = nums.get j := by
            simp only [getElem!_def, getElem?_pos, hjnums, ↓reduceIte, Option.getD_some]
            rfl
          have hjSpec := hprocessed (j : Nat) hji hjnums
