    induction l with
    | nil => exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | cons x xs ih =>
        simp only [List.map_cons] at hl
        cases hl with
        | cons hhead htail =>
            constructor
            · intro y hy
              exact hhead (a[y]) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
            · exact ih htail
  have hval_strict : is.Pairwise (fun x y => a[x] < a[y]) :=
    hmap is hval
  have hval_le : is.Pairwise (fun x y => a[x] ≤ a[y]) :=
    hval_strict.imp le_of_lt
  have hkval : a[k] ≤ a[is.getLast (List.ne_nil_of_mem hk)] :=
    hval_le.rel_getLast_of_rel_getLast_getLast hk (le_refl _)
  rw [hlast] at hkidx hkval
  exact ⟨hkidx, hkval⟩

theorem lis_idx_extend_endsAt(a : Array Int) (i j : Fin a.size) (is : List (Fin a.size))
  (h : LISIdxEndsAt a j is) (hji : j < i) (hav : a[j] < a[i]) :
  LISIdxEndsAt a i (is ++ [i]) := by
  have append_pairwise_singleton :
      ∀ {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) (xs : List α) (z : α),
        xs.Pairwise r → (∀ x ∈ xs, r x z) → (xs ++ [z]).Pairwise r := by
    intro α r xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro z hp hall
        apply List.Pairwise.cons
        · intro x hx
          simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hx
        · exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | cons x xs ih =>
        intro z hp hall
        cases hp with
        | cons hhead htail =>
            rw [List.cons_append]
            apply List.Pairwise.cons
            · intro y hy
              rcases List.mem_append.mp hy with hy | hy
              · exact hhead y hy
              · have hyz : y = z := by
                  simpa only [List.mem_singleton] using hy
                subst y
                exact hall x (by simp only [List.mem_cons, true_or])
            · apply ih z htail
              intro y hy
              exact hall y (by simp only [List.mem_cons, hy, or_true])
  simp only [LISIdxEndsAt, LISIdxSubseq] at h ⊢
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hidx, hval⟩, hlast⟩
  have hb := lis_idx_endsAt_bounds a j is ⟨⟨hidx, hval⟩, hlast⟩
  constructor
  · constructor
    · apply append_pairwise_singleton (fun x y : Fin a.size => x < y) is i hidx
      intro k hk
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hb k hk).1 hji
    · rw [List.map_append]
      change (List.map (fun i => a[i]) is ++ [a[i]]).Pairwise (fun x y => x < y)
      apply append_pairwise_singleton (fun x y : Int => x < y)
        (List.map (fun i => a[i]) is) a[i] hval
      intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_map] at hx
      rcases hx with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hb k hk).2 hav
  · rw [List.getLast?_append_cons]
    rfl

theorem lis_idx_endsAt_decompose(a : Array Int) (i : Fin a.size) (is : List (Fin a.size))
  (h : LISIdxEndsAt a i is) (hlen : 1 < is.length) :
  ∃ (j : Fin a.size) (pre : List (Fin a.size)),
    LISIdxEndsAt a j pre ∧ j < i ∧ a[j] < a[i] ∧ is = pre ++ [i] := by
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hidx, hval⟩, hlast⟩
  have his_ne : is ≠ [] := by
    intro his
    subst is
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen
    omega
  have hi : is.getLast his_ne = i := by
    have hsome : some (is.getLast his_ne) = some i := by
      rw [← hlast]
      exact (List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil his_ne).symm
    exact Option.some.inj hsome
  let pre := is.dropLast
  have hpre_ne : pre ≠ [] := by
    intro hpre
    have hlen_drop : pre.length = is.length - 1 := by
      simp only [pre, List.length_dropLast]
    rw [hpre] at hlen_drop
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen_drop
    omega
  let j : Fin a.size := pre.getLast hpre_ne
  have his_append : is = pre ++ [i] := by
    rw [← hi]
    simpa only [pre] using (List.dropLast_append_getLast his_ne).symm
  have hidx_app : (pre ++ [i]).Pairwise (· < ·) := by
    simpa only [← his_append] using hidx
  have hval_app := hval
  rw [his_append, List.map_append, List.map_singleton] at hval_app
  have hpre_idx : pre.Pairwise (· < ·) :=
    List.chain'_iff_pairwise.mp hidx_app.chain'.left_of_append
  have hpre_val : (pre.map (fun k => a[k])).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
    List.chain'_iff_pairwise.mp hval_app.chain'.left_of_append
  have hpre_last : pre.getLast? = some j := by
    simpa only [j] using List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil hpre_ne
  have hjlast : j ∈ pre.getLast? := by
    rw [hpre_last]
    simp
  have hilast : i ∈ ([i] : List (Fin a.size)).head? := by
    simp
  have hajlast : a[j] ∈ (pre.map (fun k => a[k])).getLast? := by
    simp [j, hpre_ne, hpre_last]
  have hailast : a[i] ∈ ([a[i]] : List Int).head? := by
    simp
  refine ⟨j, pre, ?_, ?_, ?_, his_append⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨hpre_idx, hpre_val⟩, hpre_last⟩
  · exact (List.chain'_append.mp hidx_app.chain').2.2 j hjlast i hilast
  · exact (List.chain'_append.mp hval_app.chain').2.2 a[j] hajlast a[i] hailast

theorem lis_innerValue_base_le(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) :
  dp[i]! ≤ LISInnerValue a dp i := by
  unfold LISInnerValue
  have hfold : ∀ (l : List Nat) (d : Int),
      d ≤ l.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro d
        exact le_rfl
    | cons j js ih =>
        intro d
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        by_cases h : a[j]! < a[i]!
        · rw [if_pos h, lis_intMax_eq_max]
          exact le_trans (le_max_left d (dp[j]! + 1)) (ih (max d (dp[j]! + 1)))
        · rw [if_neg h]
          exact ih d
  exact hfold (List.range' 0 i 1) dp[i]!

theorem lis_innerValue_pred_le(a dp : Array Int) (i j : Nat) (hji : j < i) (hav : a[j]! < a[i]!) :
  dp[j]! + 1 ≤ LISInnerValue a dp i := by
  have hmono : ∀ (l : List Nat) (d v : Int), v ≤ d →
      v ≤ l.foldl (fun d k => if a[k]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[k]! + 1) else d) d := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro d v hv
        exact hv
    | cons k l ih =>
        intro d v hv
        apply ih
        change v ≤ (if a[k]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[k]! + 1) else d)
        split_ifs with hk
        · rw [lis_intMax_eq_max]
          exact le_trans hv (le_max_left _ _)
        · exact hv
  have hscan : ∀ (l : List Nat) (d : Int), j ∈ l →
      dp[j]! + 1 ≤ l.foldl (fun d k => if a[k]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[k]! + 1) else d) d := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro d hj
        simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hj
    | cons k l ih =>
        intro d hj
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hj
        rcases hj with rfl | hj
        · apply hmono l
          change dp[j]! + 1 ≤ (if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d)
          rw [if_pos hav, lis_intMax_eq_max]
          exact le_max_right _ _
        · exact ih _ hj
  apply hscan
  rw [List.mem_range']
  exact ⟨j, hji, by omega⟩

theorem lis_innerValue_le(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (r : Int)
  (hbase : dp[i]! ≤ r)
  (hpred : ∀ j : Nat, j < i → a[j]! < a[i]! → dp[j]! + 1 ≤ r) :
  LISInnerValue a dp i ≤ r := by
  unfold LISInnerValue
  have aux : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (d : Int),
      (∀ j ∈ xs, j < i) → d ≤ r →
        xs.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d ≤ r := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro d hxs hd
        exact hd
    | cons j xs ih =>
        intro d hxs hd
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        apply ih
        · intro k hk
          exact hxs k (List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk)
        · split_ifs with h
          · rw [lis_intMax_eq_max]
            apply max_le hd
            apply hpred j
            · exact hxs j (by simp only [List.mem_cons, true_or])
            · exact h
          · exact hd
  apply aux (List.range' 0 i 1) dp[i]!
  · intro j hj
    simp only [List.mem_range'] at hj
    omega
  · exact hbase

theorem lis_innerValue_eq_base_or_pred(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) :
  LISInnerValue a dp i = dp[i]! ∨
  ∃ j : Nat, j < i ∧ a[j]! < a[i]! ∧ LISInnerValue a dp i = dp[j]! + 1 := by
  unfold LISInnerValue
  have hfold : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (d : Int),
      xs.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d = d ∨
        ∃ j : Nat, j ∈ xs ∧ a[j]! < a[i]! ∧
          xs.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d = dp[j]! + 1 := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro d
        left
        rfl
    | cons j js ih =>
        intro d
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        by_cases hj : a[j]! < a[i]!
        · simp only [hj, if_true]
          rcases ih (intMax d (dp[j]! + 1)) with h | ⟨k, hk, hak, heq⟩
          · rcases le_total d (dp[j]! + 1) with hle | hle
            · right
              refine ⟨j, List.mem_cons_self j js, hj, ?_⟩
              exact h.trans (by rw [lis_intMax_eq_max, max_eq_right hle])
            · left
              exact h.trans (by rw [lis_intMax_eq_max, max_eq_left hle])
          · right
            exact ⟨k, List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk, hak, heq⟩
        · simp only [hj, if_false]
          rcases ih d with h | ⟨k, hk, hak, heq⟩
          · left
            exact h
          · right
            exact ⟨k, List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk, hak, heq⟩
  rcases hfold (List.range' 0 i 1) dp[i]! with h | ⟨j, hj, haj, heq⟩
  · left
    exact h
  · right
    refine ⟨j, ?_, haj, heq⟩
    rw [List.mem_range'] at hj
    omega

def LISDPInv (a dp : Array Int) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  k ≤ a.size ∧ dp.size = a.size ∧
  (∀ i : Fin a.size, i.val < k → LISOptimalAt a i dp[i.val]!) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin a.size, k ≤ i.val → dp[i.val]! = 1)

theorem lis_updateAt_get_self(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hsize : dp.size = a.size) (hi : i < a.size) :
  (LISUpdateAt a dp i)[i]! = LISInnerValue a dp i := by
  rw [lis_updateAt_eq_set_inner a dp i hsize hi]
  simp [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.getElem!_eq_getD, hi, hsize]

theorem lis_updateAt_get_ne(a dp : Array Int) (i j : Nat) (hsize : dp.size = a.size) (hi : i < a.size)
  (hj : j < dp.size) (hne : j ≠ i) :
  (LISUpdateAt a dp i)[j]! = dp[j]! := by
  rw [lis_updateAt_eq_set_inner a dp i hsize hi]
  simp only [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.getElem!_eq_getD]
  have hne' : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hne
  simpa only [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds_ne hne']

theorem lis_optimalAt_zero(a : Array Int) (hzero : 0 < a.size) :
  LISOptimalAt a ⟨0, hzero⟩ 1 := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨[⟨0, hzero⟩], lis_idx_singleton_endsAt a ⟨0, hzero⟩, ?_⟩
    norm_num
  · intro is his
    have hnot : ¬ 1 < is.length := by
      intro hlen
      obtain ⟨j, pre, hpre, hji, haj, his_eq⟩ :=
        lis_idx_endsAt_decompose a ⟨0, hzero⟩ is his hlen
      have hjzero : j.val < 0 := hji
      exact (Nat.not_lt_zero j.val) hjzero
    have hle : is.length ≤ 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hle

theorem lis_innerValue_optimal(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hsize : dp.size = a.size) (hi : i < a.size)
  (hbase : dp[i]! = 1)
  (hprev : ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < i),
    LISOptimalAt a ⟨j, lt_trans hj hi⟩ dp[j]!) :
  LISOptimalAt a ⟨i, hi⟩ (LISInnerValue a dp i) := by
  unfold LISOptimalAt
  constructor
  · rcases lis_innerValue_eq_base_or_pred a dp i with hEq | ⟨j, hj, hav, hEq⟩
    · refine ⟨[⟨i, hi⟩], lis_idx_singleton_endsAt a ⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hEq, hbase]
      norm_num
    · have hjsize : j < a.size := lt_trans hj hi
      rcases (hprev j hj).1 with ⟨pre, hpre, hprelen⟩
      let jf : Fin a.size := ⟨j, hjsize⟩
      have hav' : a[j]'hjsize < a[i]'hi := by
        simpa only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getD_getElem?, hjsize, hi, dite_true] using hav
      refine ⟨pre ++ [⟨i, hi⟩], lis_idx_extend_endsAt a ⟨i, hi⟩ jf pre ?_ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [jf] using hpre
      · exact hj
      · exact hav'
      · rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hprelen, hEq]
  · intro is his
    by_cases hlen : is.length ≤ 1
    · have hnonempty : 0 < is.length := by
        rcases his.2 with hlast
        cases is with
        | nil => cases hlast
        | cons x xs => simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
      have hlen1 : is.length = 1 := by omega
      rw [hlen1, Nat.cast_one, ← hbase]
      exact lis_innerValue_base_le a dp i
    · have hlong : 1 < is.length := by omega
      rcases lis_idx_endsAt_decompose a ⟨i, hi⟩ is his hlong with ⟨j, pre, hpre, hji, hav, hisEq⟩
      have hjnat : j.val < i := hji
      have hopt := hprev j.val hjnat
      have hprele : (pre.length : Int) ≤ dp[j.val]! := hopt.2 pre hpre
      have hav' : a[j.val]! < a[i]! := by
        simpa only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getD_getElem?, j.isLt, hi, dite_true] using hav
      have hpred := lis_innerValue_pred_le a dp i j.val hjnat hav'
      rw [hisEq, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      omega

theorem lis_dpInv_init(a : Array Int) (hne : 0 < a.size) :
  LISDPInv a (Array.mkArray a.size 1) 1 := by
  unfold LISDPInv
  refine ⟨by omega, Array.size_mkArray _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hival : i.val = 0 := by omega
    have hieq : i = ⟨0, hne⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      exact hival
    subst i
    simpa only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
      Array.getElem?_mkArray_of_lt hne, Option.getD_some] using
      lis_optimalAt_zero a hne
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
      Array.getElem?_mkArray_of_lt i.isLt, Option.getD_some]

theorem lis_dpInv_step(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hinv : LISDPInv a dp i) (hi : i < a.size) :
  LISDPInv a (LISUpdateAt a dp i) (i + 1) := by
  unfold LISDPInv at hinv ⊢
  rcases hinv with ⟨hibound, hsize, hopt, hfuture⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [lis_updateAt_size, hsize]
  · intro k hk
    have hki : k.val ≤ i := by omega
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hki with hlt | heq
    · have hjsize : k.val < dp.size := by
        rw [hsize]
        exact k.isLt
      have hne : k.val ≠ i := by omega
      rw [lis_updateAt_get_ne a dp i k.val hsize hi hjsize hne]
      exact hopt k hlt
    · have hkfin : k = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext heq
      subst k
      have hbase : dp[i]! = 1 := hfuture ⟨i, hi⟩ (Nat.le_refl i)
      have hprev : ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < i),
          LISOptimalAt a ⟨j, lt_trans hj hi⟩ dp[j]! := by
        intro j hj
        exact hopt ⟨j, lt_trans hj hi⟩ hj
      rw [lis_updateAt_get_self a dp i hsize hi]
      exact lis_innerValue_optimal a dp i hsize hi hbase hprev
  · intro k hk
    have hjsize : k.val < dp.size := by
      rw [hsize]
      exact k.isLt
    have hne : k.val ≠ i := by omega
    rw [lis_updateAt_get_ne a dp i k.val hsize hi hjsize hne]
    exact hfuture k (by omega)

theorem lis_dpInv_range(a dp : Array Int) (k n : Nat) (hkn : k + n ≤ a.size)
  (hinv : LISDPInv a dp k) :
  LISDPInv a ((List.range' k n 1).foldl (LISUpdateAt a) dp) (k + n) := by
  induction n generalizing k dp with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [List.range'_zero, List.foldl_nil, Nat.add_zero] using hinv
  | succ n ih =>
      have hk : k < a.size := by omega
      have hstep : LISDPInv a (LISUpdateAt a dp k) (k + 1) :=
        lis_dpInv_step a dp k hinv hk
      have hbound : (k + 1) + n ≤ a.size := by omega
      have htail := ih (k := k + 1) (dp := LISUpdateAt a dp k) hbound hstep
      simpa only [List.range'_succ, List.foldl_cons, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm,
        Nat.add_left_comm] using htail

theorem lis_pureDP_all_optimal(a : Array Int) (i : Fin a.size) :
  LISOptimalAt a i (LISPureDP a)[i.val]! := by
  by_cases hzero : a.size = 0
  · have hi := i.isLt
    omega
  · have hne : 0 < a.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    have hinv0 := lis_dpInv_init a hne
    have hbound : 1 + (a.size - 1) ≤ a.size := by omega
    have hinv := lis_dpInv_range a (Array.mkArray a.size 1) 1 (a.size - 1) hbound hinv0
    have hsum : 1 + (a.size - 1) = a.size := by omega
    rw [hsum] at hinv
    unfold LISDPInv at hinv
    unfold LISPureDP
    exact hinv.2.2.1 i i.isLt

theorem lis_dpMax_eq_list_fold(dp : Array Int) :
  LISDPMax dp = dp.toList.foldl intMax 0 := by
  unfold LISDPMax
  cases dp with
  | mk xs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons x xs =>
          exact (Array.foldl_toList intMax 0 { toList := x :: xs }).symm

theorem lis_zero_le_fold_intMax(xs : List Int) :
  0 ≤ xs.foldl intMax 0 := by
  suffices h : ∀ (ys : List Int) (z : Int), 0 ≤ z → 0 ≤ ys.foldl intMax z by
    exact h xs 0 (le_refl 0)
  intro ys
  induction ys with
  | nil =>
      intro z hz
      exact hz
  | cons a ys ih =>
      intro z hz
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      rw [lis_intMax_eq_max]
      exact le_trans hz (le_max_left z a)

theorem lis_optimalAt_one_le(a : Array Int) (i : Fin a.size) (d : Int)
  (h : LISOptimalAt a i d) : 1 ≤ d := by
  rcases h.1 with ⟨is, his, hlen⟩
  rcases his with ⟨_, hlast⟩
  cases is with
  | nil => cases hlast
  | cons x xs =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hlen
      omega

theorem lis_idxSubseq_endsAt_getLast(a : Array Int) (is : List (Fin a.size)) (hne : is ≠ [])
  (hsub : LISIdxSubseq a is) :
  LISIdxEndsAt a (is.getLast hne) is := by
  unfold LISIdxEndsAt
  exact ⟨hsub, List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil hne⟩

theorem lis_pureDP_size(a : Array Int) :
  (LISPureDP a).size = a.size := by
  unfold LISPureDP
  have hfold : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (dp : Array Int),
      (xs.foldl (LISUpdateAt a) dp).size = dp.size := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro dp
        rfl
    | cons j xs ih =>
        intro dp
        rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
        exact lis_updateAt_size a dp j
  rw [hfold]
  simp

theorem lis_mem_toList_iff_getElem_bang(dp : Array Int) (x : Int) :
  x ∈ dp.toList ↔ ∃ (i : Nat) (hi : i < dp.size), dp[i]! = x := by
  cases dp with
  | mk xs =>
      simp only [Array.toList, Array.size]
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hex : ∃ y ∈ xs, y = x := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        rw [List.exists_mem_iff_getElem] at hex
        rcases hex with ⟨i, hi, hix⟩
        refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
        simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getD_getElem?, hi, dite_true]
        exact hix
      · rintro ⟨i, hi, hix⟩
        have hix' : xs[i] = x := by
          simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
            Array.getD_getElem?, hi, dite_true] at hix
          exact hix
        have hex : ∃ y ∈ xs, y = x := by
          rw [List.exists_mem_iff_getElem]
          exact ⟨i, hi, hix'⟩
        rcases hex with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
        rw [← hyx]
        exact hy

theorem lis_getElem_bang_le_dpMax(dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hi : i < dp.size) :
  dp[i]! ≤ LISDPMax dp := by
  have hmem : dp[i]! ∈ dp.toList :=
